numerical_conventions.comparison_rule: max absolute entry error <= atol + rtol * max absolute entry across both inputs
numerical_conventions.permutation: center held at index zero; only general-position random clouds
numerical_conventions.random_support: center zero and independent uniform coordinates in [-6,6]^3, contained within R=13 A
numerical_conventions.rigid_motion: proper orthogonal rotation plus translation; no coordinate scaling
numerical_conventions.scope: finite seeded diagnostic fixtures; not a proof or benchmark accuracy result
